careers.name: Electrical engineer
careers.about: Designs and maintains power plants, grids and building systems. Hydropower and transmission projects are the largest employers.

careers.name: Mechanical engineer
careers.about: Works on machines, plants, vehicles and maintenance. Factories, cement, energy and construction companies hire.

careers.name: Dentist
careers.about: Treats teeth and oral disease. Most dentists open their own clinic after a few years in a hospital.

careers.name: Physiotherapist
careers.about: Helps patients recover movement after injury, surgery or illness. Clinics, hospitals, sports teams and home care all hire.

careers.name: Public health officer
careers.about: Plans and runs health programmes for municipalities, NGOs and agencies. Data, outreach and reporting are daily work.

careers.name: Veterinarian
careers.about: Cares for livestock and pets, and inspects food safety. Dairy and poultry farms are growing employers.

careers.name: Designer (graphic, product, UI)
careers.about: Shapes how brands, apps and products look and feel. Agencies, startups and freelance clients abroad pay for strong portfolios.

careers.name: Police, army and APF officer
careers.about: Public safety and defence roles with steady pay, housing support and pension. Entry is competitive and fitness based.
